description: Builds a professional HTML email signature (tables and inline styles, compatible with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and Thunderbird) from the user's details. Returns the HTML, how to install it, and, if a profession is given, the legal mentions it requires in France.

accentColor.description: Hex color for the name and links, e.g. #0f766e

includeBranding.description: Adds a discreet "Signature créée avec SignaMail" line (default true, the user may remove it)

legalText.description: Small print under the signature: legal form, SIRET, regulated mentions

logoUrl.description: https URL of the company logo (PNG or JPEG). Ignored if not https

photoUrl.description: https URL of a square portrait photo. Ignored if not https

profession.description: Optional profession slug from list_professions: the answer then includes the mentions required for it

name: generate_email_signature
title: Générer une signature email
